full_judgment: 3. The petitioner has six sons and three daughters and all of them are Bangladeshis and are engaged in different business at Syedpur under the present district Nilphamari. The petitioner was present in Bangladesh on 25th day of March 1971 and never left Bangladesh and has been continuously living in Bangladesh. The petitioner is a permanent resident of Bangladesh under the law and she is not otherwise disqualified for being a citizen of Bangladesh. She swore an affidavit of allegiance to Bangladesh before the Sub-Divisional Magistrate Nilphamari on 11.11.1972 and again swore an affidavit before the 1st Class Magistrate, Syedpur on 28.3.1985. Affidavits are annexed and marked as Annexure A & A-1 respectively to the petition. The petitioner acquired the lands measuring an area of 1.90 acres appertaining to plot numbers 665, 699, 675, 671, 672, 673, 674, 678, 609, 669/844, 676 of Khatian numbers 172, 176, 177, 178, 227, 363, 374 and 375 at mouza Saptanga PS Lalmonirhat district Lalmonirhat by registered sale deed dated 6.8.1959 which was purchased from Ambika Charan. The petitioner's name has been recorded in the record of rights and she paid rents. The deed of sale and recorded porcha and rent receipts are annexure to the petition and marked as Annexures-'B', B-1', B-2' and 'B-3' respectively.
